primaryRule: At least one Hash primary improves wall and CPU by 3% and wall by 1 ms. Preserve all prior runtime/build wins, ordinary 1.05 alarms and the Go-relative RSS policy. Autonomous adoption may record remaining misses separately from this assessment.
readinessGCPolicy: Both Hash cases require identical six GC counters, automatic collection, full reclamation and live zero.
matchedCompilerIdentityPolicy: Both roles compile the exact accepted source. Accepted role must reproduce its fixed point; optimized role may emit a different compiler, but all four builds per role must have identical bytes and hashes. Compare source-matched costs separately from own-source compiler cost.
